description: A plugin module for processing 'fill in the blank' challenge sections in markdown ASTs, including validation and conversion to HTML.

methods.name: plugin
methods.description: Main function returning the transformer function for processing markdown ASTs.

methods.name: transformer
methods.description: Processes the AST to extract and validate fill-in-the-blank sections, converting them to HTML.

methods.name: getFillInTheBlank
methods.description: Extracts and formats the fill-in-the-blank data, including sentence and blanks, with validation.

methods.name: getBlanks
methods.description: Extracts blanks and feedback from the blanks nodes, grouping by thematic breaks.

methods.name: validateBlanksSectionCount
methods.description: Ensures there is exactly one '--blanks--' section in the fillInTheBlank tree.
